findings.title: Accepted maximum-size protocol lines produce unreadable operator requests
findings.exposure: A correlated blocking request at the accepted 8 MiB JSONL boundary is wrapped with metadata, exceeds the helper's 8 MiB read limit, and cannot receive an operator decision before deadline.
findings.reproduction: Send one correlated blocking item/tool/requestUserInput record exactly LIMIT bytes before newline; then call write_operator_decision for its pending request.
findings.recommendation: Bound the complete pending request below the helper read limit, or establish and enforce a dedicated consistent request-document limit; add boundary tests.
